main: Data Analyst at Northwind Bank | SQL, Power BI and Python | Helping retail teams turn customer data into weekly decisions

I started in retail operations and moved into analytics after automating the weekly sales report for my team. Today I work with customer, branch and product data to answer practical questions for commercial teams.
I enjoy writing clear SQL, building dashboards people actually open, and explaining the limits of the data. I am now looking for a role where analysis feeds product decisions directly.
• Built the branch performance dashboard in Power BI used in the weekly regional review.
• Rewrote the customer churn queries in SQL, reducing the monthly refresh from four hours to forty minutes.
• Mentored two junior analysts on query review and documentation.
• Prepared the monthly card spending report for the retail banking team, covering more than 40 branches and three customer segments.
• Cleaned and documented the customer master table with the data engineering team.
Supported the analytics team with data checks and ad hoc Excel reports.

Collected store feedback, maintained the customer survey database and prepared the quarterly summary for the marketing manager. Automated the weekly sales report in Excel, which became the reason I moved into analytics.
Designed charts and simple dashboards for two small local businesses.
